summary: Crow's nest on the east point of Junction Ridge, Chelan County, WA, dated 1933 and abandoned 1940; no source read describes the site today.

facts.design: Crow's nest atop the east point of the ridge
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts directory marks it Gone; the FFLA Washington list says Abandoned. No source read describes what, if anything, remains.

events.note: Crow's nest atop the east point, per the directory and the Kresek Inventory as cited by WillhiteWeb
Panorama photographs taken on 19 September; WillhiteWeb places them from a knob further west

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Kresek-based account places the crow's nest on the east point. WillhiteWeb says the 1934 panoramas were taken from a knob further west, and suggests the crow's nest may still have been on the east point then. The story reports both views and does not choose between them.
The Forest Lookouts directory says Gone; the FFLA Washington list says Abandoned. The record keeps status gone, which the directory supports, and the story gives both labels.

notes_for_editor: Two coordinate points: FFLA 48.37947, -120.89075 (our record) and west_us_lookouts 48.3761, -120.9039, about 1 km apart. Not resolved; the story gives no coordinates. WillhiteWeb calls the site 'Junction Mountain Lookout Site', so 'Junction Mountain' is a candidate for other_names. The 1933 and 1940 dates trace to one inventory (the Kresek Inventory) repeated on two web pages, so they are not independent confirmations. WillhiteWeb has 1934 'Looking North/Southeast/Southwest' photos; image URLs and licences were not read, so no photos entry. No source read describes the site today or its access. Brief kind 'platform' fits the vocabulary (crow's nests). Web searches used: 2. Page reads: 4.
